useCase: Binary classification of real vs. AI生成の images using ディープラーニング 特徴
mechanism: 使用します a ResNet-50 backbone pre-trained on ImageNet, replacing the final classification layer with a binary real/AI classifier. Global Average Pooling aggregates spatial 特徴 before the fully connected layer. Transfer learning enables robust 特徴 extraction from limited フォレンジック training data.
accuracy: 高 - 88-95% on in-分布 AI generators
name: ResNetバイナリ分類器
source: Wang et al. (2020) - CNN-generated Images Are Surprisingly Easy to Spot For Now, CVPR
algorithm: ResNet-50 + Global Average Pooling + FC Layer
parameters: Backbone: ResNet-50, Pre-training: ImageNet, FC output: 2 (real/AI), Input: 224x224, Optimizer: Adam, Learning rate: 1e-4
description: Fine-tuned ResNet-50 deep ニューラルネットワーク trained on large-scale real vs. AI生成の image datasets. 使用します transfer learning from ImageNet for robust 特徴 extraction.

references.title: Wang, S.Y. et al. (2020). CNN-Generated Images Are Surprisingly Easy to Spot...For Now. CVPR.
He, K. et al. (2016). Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition. CVPR.

strengths:
• Strong baseline with high 精度
• Benefits from ImageNet pre-training
• Captures both low-level and high-level 特徴
• Well-studied architecture with known properties
limitations:
• 未知のジェネレータへの汎化は限定的
• 新しいAIモデルタイプには再学習が必要
• ブラックボックス性により解釈性が制限
• 敵対的攻撃に脆弱
